EXECUTION SUBORDINATION,NONDISTURBANCE ANDATTORNMENTAGREEMENT This Subordination, Nondisturbance and Attornment Agreement (this “Agreement") is made effective as of the 30th day of November, 2018, by and between the Condominium Board of TimeWarner Center Condominium(the“Board"),havingits office at Time Warner Center (f/k/a10 Columbus Circle),NewYork,New:York 10019,andDeutscheBankAG NewYork Branch, a German corporation, having an office at c/o Jones Lang LaSalle Americas, Inc., JLL Center, 260 Forbes Avenue, Suite 1330, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania 15222 ("Tenant"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Columbus Office, LLC (Lessor") is the owner of the Time Warner Unit (Lot 1004) and the Office Unit B (Lot 1241), (together, the “Units") as defined in that certain Declaration of AOL TimeWarner Center Condominium dated as of July 22,2003(together with the Condominium By-Laws (and all exhibits) annexed thereto, as the same is now and may be amended from time to time in accordance with their terms, the “Condominium Documents") as rights tocertain Limited CommonElements;andExclusiveUse General CommonElements appurtenant thereto, all as set forth in the Condominium Documents. All capitalized terms not defined herein shall have the meanings set forth in the Condominium Documents; WHEREAS, pursuant to that certain Lease dated as of November 30, 2018 between Lessor and Tenant (such lease, as the same may be assigned, amended or restated from time to time, the “Lease"), (i) Lessor leased to Tenant that portion of the Units (together with rights to certain Limited Common Elements and Exclusive Use General Common Elements appurtenant thereto, all as set forth in the Condominium Documents), and (ii) Lessor sublicensed to Tenant that portion of the General Common Elements located on the P-2 level of the Building (the "Licensed Space") which has been licensed by the Board to Lessor pursuant to that certain license agreement dated November 30, 2018 (the “License Agreement"), all as more fully described in the License Agreement and the Lease (as such leased and sublicensed space same be expanded or reduced from time to time in accordance with the terms of the Lease, the "Leased Premises"); WHEREAS, Section 8.18 of the Lease provides that the Lease is subordinate to the Condominium Documents, subject to certain terms and conditions stated in the Lease; and WHEREAS, as permitted under the terms of the Condominium Documents, the Board has agreed to provide for the non-disturbance of Tenant by the Board, and to provide for the recognition by the Board of the Lease, including all benefits, rights and conditions that Tenant enjoys under the Lease subject to the terms hereof; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the promises and of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, the parties hereto agree as follows: USISANDLCHV17659519.12

The Board agrees that so long as: (i) the Lease is in full force and effect (including any extension or renewal period thereof which may be exercised in accordance with the terms of the Lease); and (i) Tenant is not in default under the Lease beyond any applicable notice and grace period and abides by all of the other provisions hereof, (a) the Board shall not the Board by reason of any default of the Lessor under the Condominium Documents which entitles the Board to foreclose upon its lien, any default of the Lessor under the License Agreement, or in connection with any Succession, unless required by law in order to make such action or proceeding effective, in which case the Board may join Tenant as a defendant in such action only for such purpose and not to terminate the Lease or otherwise diminish or interfere with Tenant's rights under the Lease or this Agreement in such action, (b) the Lease and Tenant's rights thereunder (including without limitation Tenant's right of possession,use and quiet enjoyment of the Leased Premises during the term of the Lease and any extension or renewal thereof in accordance with the terms of the Lease shall not be terminated, altered, disturbed or extinguished by any action of the Board or any New Owner (as hereinafter defined), including, without limitation, by any suit, action or proceeding for the foreclosure of the Leased Premises (or any portion thereof) or otherwise for the enforcement of the Board's rights or remedies under the Condominium Documents or the License Agreement, and (c) the New Owner shall, subject to the terms of this Agreement, recognize the Lease and the Tenant's rights as lessee thereunder. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, the Board and any New Owner upon becoming the owner of the applicable Unit shall have the right to pursue all rights and remedies set forth under the Lease for any default by Tenant under the Lease beyond any applicable notice and grace period. 3.If theBoard (or any New Owner) shall become the owner of a Unit by reason of the foreclosure or other action described in Paragraph 2 hereof, or a Unit shall be sold or acquired as a result of any foreclosure by the Board, or transfer of ownership by deed given in lieu of foreclosure by theBoard or a Unit shall be voluntarily surrendered to or acquired by the Board (or its designee) pursuant to the Condominium Documents, including, without limitation, Section 16.1 of the Declaration and Section 2.2.2(f) of the Condominium By-Laws or by applicable laws (collectively, a“Succession;”and the date on which such Succession occurs, the "Succession Date'), the Lease shall automatically continue in full force and effect, without necessity for executing any new lease as a direct lease between Tenant and any subsequent owner of the Unit taking title through a Succession (a “New Owner"), as “landlord,” and the Board or the New Owner, as the case may be, shall assume the Lease and all obligations of landlord thereunder, upon all of the same terms, covenants and provisions contained in the Lease, provided, however, the Board or the New Owner shall not be: (i)bound by any fixed rent which Tenant might have paid for more than one (1) month in advance of its due date under the Lease to any prior landlord (including, without limitation, Lessor); unless otherwise consented to by either the Board or the New Owner, as USISANDLCHV17659519.12
